children.name: text
children.text: Gameplane splits control across an operator, REST API, in-cluster agent sidecars, and the browser dashboard.

children.name: text
children.text: In the home cluster, console and log traffic flow API ↔ Agent directly over mTLS; the Operator provisions and reconciles both. Remote clusters go through an optional gateway (below).

children.name: text
children.text: The Operator reconciles CRDs declaratively; the API layer handles sessions, RBAC, and audit. kubectl and the dashboard always agree.

children.name: text
children.text: A dashboard action cascades: API → Operator → StatefulSet → Agent → heartbeat → status → browser refresh.

children.name: text
children.text: ModuleSource CRs declare where templates come from — OCI registry, git, HTTP, local, or dashboard upload. Standalone panels need a registered cluster for module operations.

children.name: text
children.text: One central API and dashboard can manage independent clusters, registered as Cluster resources or, in a standalone panel, in its database. Each target cluster runs its own operator, and optionally a private gateway built from the API image. The gateway has no database, no user login and no browser or admin routes. Users authenticate only to the central API, which stays the authorization authority.
